title: Tokyo Courtyard Furniture Planner with Budget Conservation
description: The user acts as an interior architect placing leather sofas around a miniature Tokyo cityscape courtyard. A fixed renovation budget constrains placement: each sofa costs resources based on its position zone, and the user must arrange exactly five sofas across three courtyard zones while respecting the budget conservation law. Full undo/redo support lets the user experiment freely.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap with ES modules from cdn.jsdelivr.net). Load LittlestTokyo.glb as a central diorama scaled to fit a 10-unit bounding box, placed at origin on a ground plane. Load SheenWoodLeatherSofa.glb and create 5 cloned instances stored off-screen in a dock panel on the left side of the UI. Setup: PerspectiveCamera at (12,10,12) looking at origin, OrbitControls, ambient light intensity 0.6, directional light from (5,10,7) with shadows enabled on a 30x30 ground plane. Define three colored courtyard zones (rings around the Tokyo model): Inner (red tint, radius<3, cost=30), Middle (yellow tint, radius 3-6, cost=20), Outer (green tint, radius>6, cost=10). Display an HTML overlay showing: total budget=100, spent=0, remaining=100, placed count, and undo/redo buttons. Interactions: (1) Click a sofa in the dock to select it (highlight with emissive). (2) Click a zone on the ground plane to place the selected sofa there at the click point, deducting zone cost from budget. (3) If budget insufficient, flash the budget display red and reject placement. (4) Click a placed sofa to select it, showing a rotation gizmo. (5) Use a slider or mouse drag to rotate the selected placed sofa around Y-axis in 45-degree snaps. (6) Double-click a placed sofa to pick it back up, returning it to the dock and refunding its zone cost (conservation law: budget always equals 100 minus sum of placed sofa costs). (7) Implement an undo/redo stack (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y and buttons) that records every place, remove, and rotate action, correctly restoring budget on undo. (8) Add a 'Submit Plan' button enabled only when all 5 sofas are placed and budget >= 0, which triggers a camera fly-around animation. Use raycasting for all click interactions. Zone rings should be semi-transparent meshes on the ground plane. Each sofa clone should cast shadows.
